<plan>1. Move towards the tree located 5 steps northwest. Collect wood by standing next to it and performing a Do action. (Collect Wood)

2. With the table already in place and the new wood, craft a Wood Pickaxe (Make Wood Pickaxe) and a Wood Sword (Make Wood Sword). (Make Wood Pickaxe, Make Wood Sword)

3. Move to the adjacent stone block to the south and Do to gather it. Then Place Stone in front of the table. (Collect Stone, Place Stone)

4. Use the Stone Pickaxe, crafted next using the newly collected stone and wood, to mine iron ore when it appears on the map, then smelt it in a furnace (after step 7). Collect the iron. (Collect Iron)

5. Place a Furnace on the table and use the furnace to smelt coal and iron into iron ingots. Craft an Iron Pickaxe and an Iron Sword. (Place Furnace, Make Iron Pickaxe, Make Iron Sword)

6. Move to the cow at 5 steps southwest and Do to eat it. (Eat Cow)

7. Place a Plant on the table and Do on it to eat the plant. (Place Plant, Eat Plant)

8. Move to the skeleton at 4 steps southwest and defeat it using the wood or stone sword. (Defeat Skeleton)

9. Search for a zombie appearance; defeat it using the sword. (Defeat Zombie)

10. Wander until a diamond block is found; use the Iron Pickaxe to mine it. (Collect Diamond)

11. Consume water (do when near a lake) to collect a drink and perform a Do on a lake to get the drink. (Collect Drink)

12. Consume or Do an action leading to sampling (e.g., do on a special item in the world) to achieve “Collect Sampling”.

13. Reduce energy by walking many steps until energy is below maximum, then Sleep. Wake up triggers the Wake Up achievement. (Wake Up)

The sequence ensures all 22 achievements are earned while maintaining health, food, and drink by eating the cow and plant, drinking when available, and resting when needed. This plan also respects the required proximity and inventory constraints for crafting. />
